parts.name: Luckfox Pico Mini
parts.spec: Mini RV1103, compatible microSD boot; excluded U202 host module.

parts.name: HOTHMI 2.8-inch eight-pin SPI LCD
parts.spec: HTM-TFT028A16-SPI, no touch, ST7789V, 88×53.3 mm. Use J1 1×8 at 2.54 mm; 3.3 V supply.
parts.warning: Carrier numbering is reversed from module J1. Its separate J2 connector is 2 mm and unused. Confirm purchased revision/header option.

parts.name: Low-profile SC3336 camera + ribbon
parts.spec: Luckfox-compatible 3 MP SC3336, low-profile assembly; plugs into the module, not the carrier.

parts.name: New pill enclosure
parts.spec: 160×70 mm carrier, raised 2.8-inch module, button plungers and card/camera/USB openings.
parts.warning: Old standard/Pico-bay cases do not fit; enclosure is not yet qualified.

parts.name: microSD + USB card reader
parts.spec: Removable microSD with enough capacity for the selected image; card reader for your Mac. Use a known-good card from a reputable supplier.

parts.name: Regulated 5 V USB-C supply + cable
parts.spec: One regulated 5 V source. This carrier is not a charger or USB-PD design; do not power multiple inputs together.

parts.name: Contact SeedKeeper card
parts.spec: Factory-installed applet; contact-capable product. Loading a secret brings it into host memory.

parts.name: Contact Satochip card
parts.spec: Factory-installed applet; contact-capable product. On-card derivation/signing; choose this instead of SeedKeeper when that is your goal.

parts.name: Blank supported JavaCard
parts.spec: J3H145 or reviewed JCOP SECID alternative with known GlobalPlatform management keys. Install an applet before use.

parts.name: Luckfox carrier sockets
parts.spec: 1×11 female, 2.54 mm pitch, 8.5 mm housing, accepts 0.64 mm square posts.

parts.name: LCD module male strip
parts.spec: 1×8 at 2.54 mm, 2.54 mm insulator, 6 mm posts; omit if J1 is correctly preheadered.

parts.name: Luckfox male strips if bare
parts.spec: 1×11 at 2.54 mm; long posts toward carrier. Omit if correctly fitted.

parts.name: Display supports
parts.spec: M2.5 female-female, 12 mm body, nominal 5 mm outside diameter.

parts.name: Display mounting screws
parts.spec: M2.5×4, four at each PCB; check engagement with any washers.

parts.name: Mounting washers if needed
parts.spec: M2.5, outside diameter no more than 5 mm in reserved hardware areas.
